target_customer: Donors who fund housing and land for low income families, mainly in Latin America; families who receive homes or land
problem: Families in poor regions lack safe housing, and donors want transparent, direct ways to fund it.
business_model: Nonprofit funded by donations, foundations and impact investing (New Story Capital); crowdfunded home builds at launch

founders.name: Matthew Marshall
founders.background_notes: YC page gives titles and impact claims only.

technical_complexity.rationale: Crowdfunding site with project tracking; the real difficulty was local construction operations and trust, not software. Later 3D printed homes with ICON added hardware complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Transparency and a donor following helped, but charities such as Habitat for Humanity operate similar building programs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or absorbed it; it expanded into land development and launched the Hometeam Ventures fund in 2021.

market_need_then: Housing shortfalls in Haiti after the earthquake and in Latin America; New Story reported funding 100 homes in 100 days in Haiti by late 2015 per its own post.

branding.domain_note: Uses newstoryhomes.org rather than a .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Photo led family and community storytelling
identity.voice_and_tone: Hopeful and community focused ('From Vacant Land to Thriving Communities').

branding.brand_signature: Donor sees the family and home they funded, with radical transparency about funds
branding.community_and_virality: Four time Fast Company Most Innovative Company recognition per YC page; coverage in TechCrunch, CNN Money and The New York Times (2021).

brand_strength.rationale: Strong press and donor storytelling and corporate partners listed on its site (Cotopaxi, Lemonade, Webflow, Redfin, Coinbase, Sotheby's); no source states the name's origin.

pivots.from: Crowdfunded homes for disaster victims starting in Haiti
pivots.to: Land development and homeownership programs in Latin America
pivots.why: Current site describes financing land, legal title and credit building; no dated source for the shift

outcome_analysis: New Story is a nonprofit that grew from crowdfunded Haiti homes into large scale housing and land programs in Latin America, partly using 3D printed homes with ICON. It reports raising over 80M, built thousands of homes and launched a venture fund in 2021. It remains active with about 20 staff on the YC page, and it is not a venture style company so no equity rounds exist.
notes: Nonprofit, so donations are not recorded as rounds. Total raised conflicts: YC page says over 80M while the founder bio says 50M plus, a Hometeam page says over 100M, and CB Insights shows 880K; none verified as a round. An IRS based profile reports 10.4M revenue in one year. Press summaries name Alexandria Lafci as a third co-founder, but she was not confirmed on the YC page or a company page so is not listed. Habitat for Humanity is the obvious comparison but no dated source was cited, so the competitor list is empty. Outcome search found ICON layoffs in 2025 and no New Story shutdown or merger.
